ms-aichain:chat-answer-prompt.doc:name: Chat answer prompt
ms-aichain:chat-answer-prompt.ms-aichain:prompt:
#["Answer ONLY from the context below. If the answer is not in the context, say you do not know. Do not invent policy details.

Context:
" ++ vars.context ++ "

Question: " ++ vars.question ]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var desc = (error.description default "") as String --- { question: vars.question, answer: null, degraded: true, reason: if ((desc contains "429") or (desc contains "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED")) "AI quota exceeded" else if ((desc contains "503") or (desc contains "UNAVAILABLE")) "AI service busy" else if ((desc contains "403") or (desc contains "401")) "AI access denied" else "AI service error", message: "The AI service is unavailable right now. Showing the most relevant policy sections instead.", excerpt: vars.sources[0].textSegment, source: vars.sources[0].fileName, retrievedChunks: vars.sources map { source: $.fileName, score: $.individualScore, text: $.textSegment } }
